lines: - Fixed an issue where a failed assertion on a [`cy.spy()`](https://on.cypress.io/spy) or [`cy.stub()`](https://on.cypress.io/stub), such as `.should('have.been.calledWith', '/log', 'flush')`, took minutes to report, or never reported, when the spy had been called with a string containing double quotes, such as JSON or HTML. The browser stopped responding while it processed the error. The failure is now reported as soon as the assertion times out. Fixes [#15005](https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress/issues/15005).

- Fixed an issue where [`cy.readFile()`](https://on.cypress.io/readfile) could fail with only "`cy.readFile()` timed out." when it ran out of time while reading the file again after a failed assertion. It now reports that the file does not exist, or the assertion that failed. Fixed in [#35432](https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress/pull/35432).

- Fixed a regression in [16.0.0](#16-0-0) where a [`cy.intercept()`](https://on.cypress.io/intercept) response larger than about 75 MB stopped the run in Chromium-based browsers. The next command, such as another `cy.intercept()`, never finished, and in `cypress open` the **Re-run** button stayed on "Your tests are loading...". Fixes [#34964](https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress/issues/34964) and [#35025](https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress/issues/35025).

+- Fixed a regression in [16.0.0](#16-0-0) where, in Chromium-based browsers, mostly on Windows, a run could hang with no error when the app loaded a script or page of a few MB or more that Cypress rewrites, such as a large JavaScript bundle. For example, a [`cy.visit()`](https://on.cypress.io/visit) of a page loading an 8 MB bundle never finished and [`pageLoadTimeout`](https://on.cypress.io/configuration#Timeouts) never fired; the page now loads. If Cypress still loses its connection to the browser tab, the run now ends with an error instead of hanging. Fixes [#34969](https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress/issues/34969).

- Fixed a regression in [15.18.1](#15-18-1) where, after clicking **Start E2E Testing**, the Launchpad could stay on the disabled **Opening** button after the browser had opened, and the **Focus** and **Close** buttons never appeared until you switched testing types. Fixes [#35364](https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress/issues/35364).

- Fixed a regression in [16.0.0](#16-0-0) where a [`cy.intercept()`](https://on.cypress.io/intercept) response handler that changed the `Location` or `Referrer-Policy` header of a redirect had no effect in Chromium-based browsers. The browser followed the redirect as the server sent it, to the server's URL and with the server's referrer policy. Fixes [#34704](https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress/issues/34704).

- Fixed a regression in [16.0.0](#16-0-0) where a [`cy.intercept()`](https://on.cypress.io/intercept) response handler that changed the `Content-Type` header of a streamed response, such as `text/event-stream` or an `EventSource`, replaced the stream with an empty body in Chromium-based browsers. The stream now reaches the page with the new `Content-Type`. A handler that sets `res.body` still replaces the stream. Fixes [#35256](https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress/issues/35256).
